correctness.rationale: Distance classes are unions of unordered-pair orbits. Pair-orbit valencies sum to n-1; valency-one orbits inject into involutions of the centralizer. For a transitive group the centralizer is semiregular, so its order divides 2m. When m is odd it has at most m involutions. The resulting upper bound matches the published D_m lower construction.
